etymarab.kok_maddesi: Back to library EtymArab SRQN سرقن BP … • © SG | 28Feb2026 √SRQN "root" ▪ SRQN_1 ‘dung, manure’ ↗ sirqīn ▪ SRQN_2 ‘red lead, minium’: sariqūn , var. of ↗ salaqūn (arranged s.r. ↗√SLQ) Other values, now obsolete, include (Dozy1927): ▪ † SRQN_3 ‘basket’: † sarqāniyyaẗ ; see ↗ † SRQ_14 ▪ [v1] : sirqīn ‘dung, manure’ also appears with the variants sarqīn and sirǧīn . It is borrowed (via Syr sarqīnā , Mnd sarqina ) from Pers sark/gīn ( sargēn – Asbaghi1988). In Lane1872 the meaning is specified as ‘dung of horses or other solid-hoofed animal, dung of camels, sheep and goats, wild oxen, and the like; a manure for land’. ▪ [v2] : sariqūn ‘red lead, minium’ is a var. of ↗ salaqūn ~ salāqūn , which is more common than sariqūn although, etymologically, the latter is perh. closer to the foreign etymon. For further details, see ↗ salaqūn (arranged s.r. ↗√SLQ). ▪ † [v3] : † sarqāniyyaẗ for a type of ‘basket’ is equated by Dozy1927 with Grk σαργάνη ( sargánē ) ‘wicker basket’. ▪ … – – (all SRQN items are of non-Ar origin). ▪ See above, section CONC. ▪ … ▪ [v2] : Tu süleğen ~ sülüğen ‘red lead, minium’. – Sources ; meta ; gram ; engl ; conc ; hist ; cogn ; disc ; west ; deriv ;
